name: Cutrim Unzip Patch

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "*.zip"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  unzip:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Find uploaded ZIP
        id: patch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BEFORE="${{ github.event.before }}"
          PATCH=""

          if [ -n "$BEFORE" ] && [ "$BEFORE" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
            PATCH="$(git diff --name-only "$BEFORE" "$GITHUB_SHA" -- '*.zip' \
              | grep -E '^[^/]+\.zip$' \
              | tail -n 1 || true)"
          fi

          if [ -z "$PATCH" ] || [ ! -f "$PATCH" ]; then
            echo "No newly uploaded ZIP found in repo root."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "file=$PATCH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Patch: $PATCH"

      - name: Unzip patch to repo root
        shell: bash
        env:
          PATCH_FILE: ${{ steps.patch.outputs.file }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          import stat
          import zipfile
          from pathlib import Path

          root = Path(".").resolve()
          archive = Path(os.environ["PATCH_FILE"]).resolve()

          with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "r") as z:
              for info in z.infolist():
                  name = info.filename.replace("\\", "/")

                  if not name or name.endswith("/"):
                      continue

                  target = (root / name).resolve()

                  if target != root and root not in target.parents:
                      raise SystemExit(f"Unsafe ZIP path: {name}")

                  if name == ".git" or name.startswith(".git/"):
                      raise SystemExit("Patch cannot modify .git")

                  file_type = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
                  if file_type == stat.S_IFLNK:
                      raise SystemExit(f"Symlink not allowed: {name}")

              z.extractall(root)

          print(f"Applied: {archive.name}")
          PY

      - name: Remove ZIP and commit patch
        shell: bash
        env:
          PATCH_FILE: ${{ steps.patch.outputs.file }}
        run: |
          rm -f "$PATCH_FILE"

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add -A

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes after patch."
          else
            git commit -m "Apply Cutrim patch"
            git push
          fi
